Century Real Estate: Bengaluru Homes and Communities

Century Real Estate is a Bengaluru-based premier property development and investment company founded in 1973 by Dr. P. Dayananda Pai and Mr. P. Satish Pai. With over five decades of industry leadership, the company has grown into one of India’s most trusted full-spectrum developers and largest landowners.

Driven by its core motto, "Thinking Ahead," Century Real Estate has helped shape Bengaluru’s urban landscape through iconic landmark projects, premium residential communities, luxury apartments, and plotted developments.

Explore Century Real Estate in Bangalore, including apartments, homes, and plotted developments across established and emerging neighbourhoods. Compare projects from Century builders by location, configuration, floor plans, amenities, and possession to find a home that suits your needs.

Architectural Overview

Century Liva is a luxury residential development by Century Real Estate located on Doddaballapur Main Road, Yelahanka. Spread across 3 acres with 80% open green space, the project features 247 exclusive apartments with modern lifestyle amenities and connectivity to Kempegowda International Airport. Buyers researching Century Real Estate in Bangalore can explore homes in Yelahanka, Bengaluru, with project status, location, and configuration details to compare.

Century Liva is listed with 2, 3, and 4 BHK configurations and a December 2028 possession timeline. Residents can explore landscaped gardens and lifestyle amenities, with nearby destinations including BMS Institute of Technology, Ramada by Wyndham, and Mallya Aditi International School.
